_about: Parameters of a Waveshare PiRacer Pro and its track. status: verified = manufacturer spec; measured = from this vehicle (its config or our own tests); assumed = temporary simulation placeholder for an UNKNOWN value -- it has a range, is swept rather than trusted, and must be replaced by measuring it (sim/CALIBRATION.md). Edit values here; never edit the code to change a number.

wheelbase_m.source: Waveshare PiRacer Pro wiki: wheelbase ~174.1 mm

motor.value: RC380 brushed, 15000 rpm unloaded (motor shaft, NOT wheel speed; gearing and wheel size unpublished)

camera_sensor.value: OV5647, 160 deg wide-angle (diagonal vs horizontal not stated)

camera_fov_deg.source: Waveshare: 160 deg FOV. ASSUMED to be the diagonal FOV of an equidistant fisheye -- confirm with CALIBRATION.md step 7

steer_pwm_left.source: ~/mycar/myconfig.py STEERING_LEFT_PWM (read 2026-11-08; re-confirm when the Pi is back)

pwm_channels.value: PCA9685 bus 1 addr 0x40: ch0 steering, ch1 throttle

camera_fps.source: CAMERA_FRAMERATE = 20; ~20 distinct frames/s seen on the live stream

processing_s.source: Detector+overlay time on the Pi: 17 ms offline, 33-51 ms while driving

thr_cmd_moves.source: Stick test 2026-11-08: wheels turn from stick ~0.45-0.55 (PWM ~387-390); 0.30 (PWM 381) did not move the car. Rough: refine with CALIBRATION.md step 3

steer_angle_table.source: UNKNOWN. Placeholder linear map, +/-25 deg at the PWM limits, straight at 375 (Donkeycar's midpoint). Measure the turning radius at several PWM values: CALIBRATION.md step 2

servo_rate_dps.source: UNKNOWN (servo speed not published). Measure: CALIBRATION.md step 6

servo_tau_s.source: UNKNOWN. First-order lag on top of the slew limit. CALIBRATION.md step 6

actuator_delay_s.source: UNKNOWN: PCA9685 update + ESC/servo response. CALIBRATION.md step 8

speed_table.source: UNKNOWN. Placeholder: deadband to PWM 387 (matches the stick test), linear to 1.8 m/s at 407. Measure timed runs per PWM: CALIBRATION.md step 3

start_pwm.source: PWM needed to start from rest (static friction). Stick test suggests ~387-390. CALIBRATION.md step 3

brake_coast.source: UNKNOWN: deceleration with throttle at neutral. CALIBRATION.md step 4

brake_active.source: UNKNOWN: deceleration with reverse PWM while moving (ESC brake). CALIBRATION.md step 4

mu_lat.source: UNKNOWN tyre-to-mat grip (max lateral accel / 9.81). CALIBRATION.md step 5

cam_height_m.source: UNKNOWN (must be under the 0.215 m body height). Measure: CALIBRATION.md step 7

cam_pitch_deg.source: DERIVED, not measured: real frames show the horizon at ~0.42 of image height; under the 160-deg-diagonal equidistant fisheye model that means ~8 deg down. Measure directly: CALIBRATION.md step 7

meas_noise.source: Line-position jitter on parked frames ~0.005 (rough); varies with lighting

meas_dropout.source: Frames with no usable line on a good track (rough, from runs)

track_straight_m.source: UNKNOWN: measure the stage track (CALIBRATION.md step 1)

lane_width_m.unit: m (left tape inside edge to right tape inside edge)
lane_width_m.source: DERIVED, not measured: with the camera model above, 0.53 m reproduces the 0.47-of-width gap between the lines seen on real frames at the lookahead row. Measure with a tape measure: CALIBRATION.md step 1
